The '''Battle of the Veil Nebula''' was the final battle in the campaign of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The battle==
During the [[Battle of the Hexus system]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] attached a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] to [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane's]] [[Tempest Zero/Legends|Tempest Zero]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], which allowed the Republic to find his base - the [[Harko Station]] in the [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]]. A large task force was sent to destroy the base, with [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] of the [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptors]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and Skywalker's [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor]] prototype occupying attention of the enemy starfighters, while [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyers]] bombarded the station. During the battle the Valahari activated a transmission which replicated a nesting neebray brood mother. This led the local [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]] to attack the Republic forces. However, the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] of the [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] managed to destroy the station and thus disable the transmission. The leader of the [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|Tofen's Raiders]] Tofen Vane was killed in a dogfight against Skywalker.
